name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: A battered parchment map sets Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure in motion along Westfall's coast. The hunt begins with a search of the shoreline for the late captain's personal footlocker, then leads toward his hidden plunder across the region.

sections.title: A Sailor's Last Bequest
sections.body: Shipwrecks and the restless spirits of drowned sailors mark Westfall's western coast. Captain Sanders, an old seafarer, met a watery grave there. He left cryptic instructions so his hard-won fortune would not be lost to the Great Sea or taken by scavengers. A determined adventurer can retrace the trail he left behind.

sections.title: The Rusty Anchor
sections.body: The first clue points to a lone rusty anchor in the surf on Westfall's western coast. Near a wreck, half-buried in the sand, lies Captain Sanders' old footlocker, battered by the waves. Inside are seawater, sand, and a scurrying crab clutching the next piece of Sanders' puzzle.

faq.answer: Captain Sanders was an old sea captain whose map says he lies in a watery grave. He left the map and a series of clues leading to his hidden plunder.
The footlocker lies half-buried in the sand along Westfall's western coast, near a solitary rusty anchor by the shoreline.

faq.q: Does the footlocker contain the captain's treasure?
faq.answer: The map directs you to a footlocker and the next clue in a longer treasure hunt.

faq.q: How many clues are in Captain Sanders' treasure hunt?
faq.answer: The hunt has four steps across Westfall's coast and countryside, beginning with the map and ending with Captain Sanders' actual treasure chest on an island off the coast.

faq.q: Why did Captain Sanders bury his treasure in Westfall?
faq.answer: Captain Sanders' map never says why he chose Westfall. It says he expected to meet a watery grave and wanted whoever followed his clues to find his treasure, with clues spread across the coast and the bluffs above it.

faq.q: Can Horde players follow this treasure map?
faq.answer: Yes. Captain Sanders' map and clues are neutral, so any adventurer who reaches Westfall's coast can follow his trail.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know the value of following a dead sailor's map along a lawless coast. A pirate's treasure hunt suits scoundrels and privateers.
As an Alliance adventurer, recovering fortune from Westfall's wreck-strewn coast is a small victory amid the kingdom's frontier turmoil, where coastal murlocs menace the shore.
